items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: That was his oldest brother, Walter Johnson.

ctx.x: Did she teach other students, too?

Oh yes. She was a great piano teacher. And his older brother was a great pianist. He was really great. He was very outstanding all over the City of Boston. He played all the Society affairs and one thing or another, and he had four or five different combinations working on the same night -- all the Society affairs. That was his oldest brother, Walter Johnson. But he was a great deal older than Howard was.
And Walter Johnson was a pianist.
